task: Implement the production Kilo completion-signal emitter identified by Gemini research. At Kilo task completion, create the durable Git evidence file poc/signals/<request_id>.json, commit it, and push it to main so the existing GitHub push webhook consumer can correlate the completion and trigger the existing Gemini handoff.

result.summary: Implemented production Kilo completion-signal emitter module (poc/signal-emitter.js) and focused tests (test/signal-emitter.test.js). The emitter builds, validates against the existing validateSignal() contract, and writes poc/signals/<request_id>.json completion signals for success, failure, and blocked states. Duplicate and conflicting signal prevention is enforced. All 41 new tests and 337 existing regression tests pass.
